node_hash_note: The Gate 2 workflow artifact was emitted with CRLF line endings, while the committed repository CSV is canonical LF text. Coordinates, node identities, row order, and scientific content are identical; both byte identities are retained explicitly.

transport_mirror.provenance: This exact asset size and SHA-256 were obtained in EOG GitHub Actions run 31946684346 before any SIVFLORA incidence outcome was computed. It is frozen here before any Azores species-island incidence, world-set outcome, or confirmatory statistic is opened.

sampling_rule: direct raster sample at immutable GeoNames longitude/latitude; no snapping, nearby-cell substitution, interpolation, imputation, coordinate replacement, island drop or resolution change
coverage_rule: every declared variable from both declared products must be finite and non-nodata at all nine frozen nodes
transport_rule: try the declared UC Davis WorldClim route first; if transport fails before climate coverage is observed, the exactly frozen WorldClimData release asset may be used only after byte-size and SHA-256 verification; this changes no logical product, version, resolution, variable, node, sampling rule or missing-value rule
stop_rules: stop if any CHELSA or WorldClim variable is missing/nodata at any frozen node
do not move, snap, replace or drop a frozen node after coverage is observed
do not change WorldClim resolution or substitute a different climate product after coverage is observed
do not change the frozen WorldClim transport mirror identity after coverage or outcome information is observed
do not parse species-island incidence or construct the EOG world universe in this gate
